_comment: The one machine-readable statement of the self-hosted runner pool's size.
scripts/check-pool-facts.sh checks every prose statement in the tree
against this file, and .github/workflows/pool-live-count.yml checks this
file daily against the runners registered on the repo (`--live`, #886).
GITHUB_TOKEN has no `administration` permission scope, so it cannot list
runners; that job uses the read-only Administration:read PAT which
Bounds: it counts REGISTERED runners, online or not, as the union of
runner names over spaced reads (defaults in the script), because the x64 pool registers
one JIT runner per job and a single read can be one short; a resize
shows up to a day late. Escape: `bash scripts/check-pool-facts.sh --live`
by hand with any token that has admin access to the repo, which is also
the only comparison until that workflow is on the default branch.
measured: 2026-10-05, repos/claymore666/docker-net-dhcp/actions/runners over spaced reads: 16 names dhcp-ci-1..16 carrying `dhcp-ci` (ids change per job), plus rpi-arm64-1 carrying `dhcp-ci-arm64` (17 registered in total, which is the number the API prints and the number this file exists to stop anyone quoting as the pool).
